map.肺康复呼吸肌训练强度计算器 使用指南: Pulmonary Rehab Respiratory Muscle Training Intensity Calculator User Guide
map.依据最大吸气压(MIP)/最大呼气压(MEP)计算呼吸肌训练(RMT)强度、频率: Compute respiratory muscle training (RMT) intensity, frequency and prescription from maximal inspiratory pressure (MIP) and maximal expiratory pressure (MEP), for pulmonary rehab in COPD and similar conditions
map.：下限=75−0.5×60=45；MIP 60>45 不弱；力量目标训练=60×: Lower limit = 75 - 0.5 x 60 = 45; an MIP of 60 is above 45 so not weak; the strength target training load = 60 x 0.35 = about 21 cmH2O.
map.：MIP<下限→吸气肌薄弱，从 30–50% MIP 起渐进负荷。: MIP below the lower limit means weak inspiratory muscles; start progressive loading at 30-50% of MIP.
map.力量 30–50% MIP、耐力 20–30% MIP，每日分次训练。: Strength at 30-50% of MIP, endurance at 20-30% of MIP, trained in sessions spread through the day.
map.MIP/MEP 反映吸气/呼气肌，低于年龄下限提示易疲劳。: MIP/MEP reflect the inspiratory and expiratory muscles; below the age-specific lower limit suggests susceptibility to fatigue.
